# Electronic Patient Record

> Open-source electronic patient record software. A pre-release scaffold: not for clinical use. Do not enter real patient data.

- [Home](https://electronic-patient-record.github.io/): what the project is
- [Benefits](https://electronic-patient-record.github.io/locales/en-001/benefits/): what it is designed to give
- [Features](https://electronic-patient-record.github.io/locales/en-001/features/): built, and designed but not built
- [Compare](https://electronic-patient-record.github.io/compare/): how it differs, and where others are ahead
- [Tutorial](https://electronic-patient-record.github.io/locales/en-001/tutorial/): a first explained match
- [Status](https://electronic-patient-record.github.io/locales/en-001/status/): what is and is not built
- [Research](https://electronic-patient-record.github.io/locales/en-001/research/): the desk research behind the specification
- [About](https://electronic-patient-record.github.io/locales/en-001/about/): how the project works
- [Sitemap](https://electronic-patient-record.github.io/sitemap.xml)
- [Source](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record): the code and specification

Also in Welsh (/locales/cy-gb/, /locales/cy-001/), Mandarin in Simplified Chinese (/locales/zh-cn/, /locales/zh-001/), Arabic (/locales/ar-001/) and Hindi (/locales/hi-in/, /locales/hi-001/), machine-written and not reviewed by a speaker.
